name: ClashBall.io
author: Addicting Games
description:
ClashBall.io is an exciting, competitive, fast-paced multiplayer game that requires precise timing, sharp focus and strategic gameplay.
Set in a dynamic, enclosed arena, players must avoid a dangerous homing ball that relentlessly chases them, knocking them out with a hit.
The ball will turn red when it's targeting you. Slash it with your weapon at the right time to deflect it toward an opponent, but be warned: each deflection causes the ball to accelerate, making it even harder to dodge.
Level up to unlock unique abilities that give you the edge in battle. Use your special power wisely to outsmart and eliminate your rivals.
The ultimate goal? Be the last player standing to claim victory!
Earn coins, open skin boxes and unlock a variety of outfits, hats, hairstyles and swords. Customize your character and show off your champion status in style!
